title: Specify adapter manifest
description: Validates the structure of a Specify adapter manifest (adapter.yaml). The manifest is the declarative surface the core loads before running the slice loop. Defined by RFC-13 §Adapter manifest and protocol; the manifest field set is closed (additionalProperties: false) so the dropped fields domain, extends, and pipeline.plan are actively rejected rather than tolerated. Planning is orchestration, not adapter-owned slice work, and lives on the `specify change` planning skill (`plugins/change/skills/plan/`); see RFC-13 §3.11 for the migration that landed this rejection.

name.description: Adapter identifier in kebab-case (e.g. omnia, contracts, vectis). Must match the directory name under adapters/.

version.description: Major adapter version. Increments when the adapter ships breaking pipeline or contract changes.

description.description: Human-readable, single-sentence summary of the adapter's outcome domain.

pipeline.description: Ordered briefs the core renders for each fixed slice phase. The manifest contains only the three slice phases (define, build, merge); planning is platform-component territory owned by the `specify change` planning skill (`plugins/change/skills/plan/`). RFC-13 §3.11 dropped the transitional `pipeline.plan` property — `additionalProperties: false` actively rejects it now (and any other unrecognised phase).

define.description: Ordered briefs for the define phase. At least one brief is required.

build.description: Ordered briefs for the build phase. At least one brief is required.

merge.description: Ordered briefs for the merge phase. At least one brief is required.

id.description: Brief identifier in kebab-case. Must be unique within the manifest and must match the brief file's frontmatter id.

brief.description: Path to the brief markdown file, relative to the adapter manifest. Must not be an absolute path or a URI.
